description: Remove a shortcut binding by its KeyboardEvent.code. Reports whether it existed.
name: delete_shortcut

description: The full config: grid (rows, cols, windowGap, screenMargins), keybindings (openPanel hotkey; "" = none), shortcuts (assignment + keys), api (port, enabled).
name: get_config

description: Everything about Vindue right now: Accessibility trust, the current target window (frontmost), all monitors with canonical labels, and the full config (grid, keybindings, shortcuts, api). Call this first.
name: get_state

description: Running apps that own windows: pid and name — pass either to tile_window's app parameter.
name: list_apps

description: All connected displays: canonical label (use these strings to target monitors — twins get positional suffixes like "(left)"/"(right)"), position, size, work area, and scale factor.
name: list_monitors

description: The shortcuts config: assignment mode (pinned binds new shortcuts to the monitor they are created on; relative follows the panel's monitor) plus every key → { monitor, selection } binding.
name: list_shortcuts

description: Update the grid: rows/cols (1-12), windowGap and screenMargins (px 0-300). Only the fields passed change. Stored shortcuts that no longer fit are rescaled proportionally, and open panel/Settings views refresh.

height.description: Vertical gap between tiled windows, px 0-300.

width.description: Horizontal gap between tiled windows, px 0-300.

bottom.description: Margin inset from the bottom of the work area, px 0-300.

left.description: Margin inset from the left of the work area, px 0-300.

right.description: Margin inset from the right of the work area, px 0-300.

top.description: Margin inset from the top of the work area, px 0-300.

cols.description: Grid columns, 1-12. Omit to leave unchanged.

rows.description: Grid rows, 1-12. Omit to leave unchanged.

screenMargins.description: Margins inset from the screen edges, px 0-300.

name: set_grid

description: Set or clear the global hotkey that opens the Vindue panel (e.g. "CommandOrControl+Alt+S"; "" = none). Registration fails if macOS or another app owns the combo — the error will say so.

keys.description:
Accelerator string like "CommandOrControl+Alt+S", or "" to remove the
global open-panel hotkey.

name: set_hotkey

description: Set screen margins (px 0-300) inset from each edge of every display's work area.

bottom.description: Margin inset from the bottom of the work area, px 0-300.

left.description: Margin inset from the left of the work area, px 0-300.

right.description: Margin inset from the right of the work area, px 0-300.

top.description: Margin inset from the top of the work area, px 0-300.

name: set_margins

description: Create or update a keyboard shortcut that tiles the frontmost window into the given grid cells. Pass a monitor label from list_monitors (or index) to pin it to a display; omit monitor for a relative shortcut.

endCol.description: Last grid column of the region (inclusive).

endRow.description: Last grid row of the region (inclusive).

startCol.description: First grid column of the region (0-based, inclusive).

startRow.description: First grid row of the region (0-based, inclusive).

monitor.description:
Monitor label from list_monitors or index to pin this shortcut to a
display. Omit for a relative shortcut that follows whichever monitor
the panel is on.

selection.description: Grid cells (inclusive) the shortcut tiles into.

name: set_shortcut

description: Set whether new shortcuts are "pinned" to the monitor they are created on or "relative" (following the panel's monitor).

assignment.description:
"pinned" (new shortcuts bind to the monitor they are created on) or
"relative" (shortcuts follow the panel's monitor).

name: set_shortcut_assignment

description: Move and resize a window to a grid region. Presets: full, left_half, right_half, top_half, bottom_half, top_left, top_right, bottom_left, bottom_right — or pass explicit inclusive cells. Targets the frontmost window by default; pass an app name or pid for another app. The monitor defaults to the one holding the target window.

endCol.description: Last grid column of the region (inclusive).

endRow.description: Last grid row of the region (inclusive).

startCol.description: First grid column of the region (0-based, inclusive).

startRow.description: First grid row of the region (0-based, inclusive).

anyOf.description: Process id of the app to tile.
App name (exact match first, else substring; case-insensitive).

app.description: App to tile — pid or name. Defaults to the frontmost window.

cells.description: Explicit grid cells — use instead of preset.

monitor.description:
Monitor to tile on: canonical label from list_monitors (e.g.
"DELL U2720Q (left)"), a monitor index, or "current". Defaults to the
display holding the target window.

preset.description:
Named region: full, left_half, right_half, top_half, bottom_half,
top_left, top_right, bottom_left, bottom_right.

name: tile_window
